fact: The World Bank results brief says the eCRVS birth-registration system integrated the Ministry of Interior's national ID system with the Ministry of Health's civil registration, and that between August 2022 and February 2023 it issued about 1.17 million people birth certificates and health insurance cards carrying a unique national identification number.
system: eCRVS (electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics)
source_slug: 2024-03-28 A Transformative Journey of Mass Birth Registration and Health Insurance in The Gambia

fact: The World Bank ID4D diagnostic says the national ID's NIN was populated into the eCRVS to cross-verify parents' IDs when new NINs were issued after the mass enrolment.

The diagnostic says the Drivers License System uses the National ID system for biometric verification of applicants to prevent identity fraud and duplication; no date is given, so the document's 2025 publication year is used.

The diagnostic says user acceptance testing of an integrated eCRVS and electronic ID to produce health insurance cards was completed in April 2025, with testing for driver's licence and ID cards due in May 2025, under World Bank operation P173287.
system: Integrated eCRVS/eID health insurance card production

fact: The diagnostic says the HR/Payroll module of the Gambia Public Procurement and Payment Management System is being designed for API integration with the National ID to automate government payroll.
system: Gambia Public Procurement & Payment Management System (HR/Payroll module)
